    result = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=source, env={**os.environ, 'PYTHONPATH': str(source / 'src')}, text=True, capture_output=True)

import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import random

import chess

root = pathlib.Path('/workspace/HarbiChess')
out = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-policy-search-arena-20261003'
book = json.loads((root / 'docs/research/UFUK-policy-search-opening-splits-20261003.json').read_text())['splits']['arena']
report = {'status': 'pass', 'games': 0, 'plies': 0, 'caps': 0, 'arms': {}}
for name in ['raw-vs-search', 'raw-vs-stockfish32', 'search-vs-stockfish32']:
    p = out / (name + '.json')
    d = json.loads(p.read_text())
    assert len(d['games']) == 48
    for i, g in enumerate(d['games']):
        moves = book[i // 2]['opening']['moves']
        assert g['opening_pair'] == i // 2 and g['opening'] == moves and g['moves'][:len(moves)] == moves
        assert g['candidate_color'] == ('white' if i % 2 == 0 else 'black')
        b = chess.Board()
        for uci in g['moves']:
            m = chess.Move.from_uci(uci)
            assert m in b.legal_moves
            b.push(m)
        assert b.ply() == g['plies']
        outcome = b.outcome(claim_draw=True)
        if outcome:
            assert outcome.termination.name.lower() == g['termination']
            expected = 0.5 if outcome.winner is None else float(outcome.winner == (g['candidate_color'] == 'white'))
        else:
            assert b.ply() == 240 and g['termination'] == 'max_plies'
            expected = 0.5
            report['caps'] += 1
        assert expected == g['score']
        report['games'] += 1
        report['plies'] += len(g['moves'])
    report['arms'][name] = {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'summary': d['summary'], 'wall_seconds': d['wall_seconds'], 'evaluated_positions': d['evaluated_positions']}
left = report['arms']['raw-vs-stockfish32']['summary']['pair_scores']
right = report['arms']['search-vs-stockfish32']['summary']['pair_scores']
diff = [a - b for a, b in zip(left, right, strict=True)]
rng = random.Random(20261008)
samples = sorted(sum(rng.choices(diff, k=24)) / 24 for _ in range(10000))
report['raw_minus_search_sf32'] = {'mean': sum(diff) / 24, 'pair_differences': diff, 'conditional_bootstrap_95': [samples[249], samples[9749]]}
report['primary_passed'] = report['arms']['raw-vs-search']['summary']['score'] > 0.6 and report['arms']['raw-vs-search']['summary']['bootstrap_pair_95'][0] > 0.5 and report['arms']['raw-vs-search']['summary']['capped_games'] <= 4
report['scope'] = 'Registered selector development comparison; reused families/fresh stress roots, unknown caps diagnostic only, no general Elo or self-learning.'
p = out / 'integrity-audit.json'
assert not p.exists()
p.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
